name: Payment Transaction 183
definition: Data associated with a transaction process by a Point Of Interaction.

TransactionCapture.name: Transaction Capture
TransactionCapture.definition: Flag indicating whether the transaction data must be captured or not in addition to the message process.|Usage: When absent, default value is False.

PaymentInstrument.name: Payment Instrument
PaymentInstrument.definition: Set of possible payment instruments from which one will apply to this transaction.

PaymentTypeInformation.name: Payment Type Information
PaymentTypeInformation.definition: Further details related to the set of payment types.

TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Type of transaction being undertaken for the main service.

AdditionalService.name: Additional Service
AdditionalService.definition: Service in addition to the main service.

ServiceAttribute.name: Service Attribute
ServiceAttribute.definition: Additional attribute of the service type.

LastTransactionFlag.name: Last Transaction Flag
LastTransactionFlag.definition: Flag indicating processing of the last transaction.| Usage: When absent, default value is  True.

MerchantCategoryCode.name: Merchant Category Code
MerchantCategoryCode.definition: Category code conform to ISO 18245, related to the type of services or goods the merchant provides for the transaction.

SaleReferenceIdentification.name: Sale Reference Identification
SaleReferenceIdentification.definition: Global reference of the sale transaction for the sale system.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the initiator of the request. For instance refers to POITransactionIdentification if used inside an authorisation request or to SaleTransactionIdentification if the message is a payment request initiated by a sale system.

ReconciliationIdentification.name: Reconciliation Identification
ReconciliationIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the Acquirer/Acceptor reconciliation period.

IssuerReferenceData.name: Issuer Reference Data
IssuerReferenceData.definition: Identification of the transaction given by the Issuer.

IssuerCITIdentification.name: Issuer CIT Identification
IssuerCITIdentification.definition: Identification, given by the Issuer, of the transaction processed with the cardholder that legitimates this merchant initiated transaction.

MerchantCITIdentification.name: Merchant CIT Identification
MerchantCITIdentification.definition: Identification, given by the merchant, of the transaction processed with the cardholder that legitimates this merchant initiated transaction.

MerchantReferenceData.name: Merchant Reference Data
MerchantReferenceData.definition: Merchant information that must be returned unchanged in the response.

CustomerConsent.name: Customer Consent
CustomerConsent.definition: Indicates if the customer has explicitly validated a choice.|Usage: When absent, default value is False.

CardProgrammeProposed.name: Card Programme Proposed
CardProgrammeProposed.definition: Specifies the card program proposed by a retailer to a cardholder among a series of payment programmes offered by the retailer.

CardProgrammeApplied.name: Card Programme Applied
CardProgrammeApplied.definition: Specifies the card program actually selected by the cardholder among the ones supported by the retailer and/or the one actually proposed to him.

SaleToPOIData.name: Sale To POI Data
SaleToPOIData.definition: Specifies element that the sale system wants to store in the POI system.

SaleToAcquirerData.name: Sale To Acquirer Data
SaleToAcquirerData.definition: Sale information intended for the Acquirer.

SaleToIssuerData.name: Sale To Issuer Data
SaleToIssuerData.definition: Sale information intended for the Issuer.

AdditionalTransactionData.name: Additional Transaction Data
AdditionalTransactionData.definition: Additional information related to the transaction.

MessageFromMerchant.name: Message From Merchant
MessageFromMerchant.definition: Message from a merchant to be displayed on the cardholder bank statement.
